net_seconds_saved_per_hour.note: Stall seconds saved minus seconds lost to interruptions, per hour of work.

p1_false_nudges_per_hour.note: A design target (at most 1.0 an hour), not a measured tolerance.

p2_seconds_to_resume_paired_diff.note: Seconds from the first cue to resuming, with Cue minus the no-cue remaining stall, per cued stall; negative is faster.

silence_precision.note: Share of silent moments that were genuinely not stuck; always staying silent scores the baseline.

cue.split: held-out population seed 77 (40 workers), replicate seeds [1000, 1001, 1002, 1003, 1004]

meta.note: Simulated; run once after evals/cue/PLAN.md was committed.

gaming.reading: flat learners whose true skill never changes; a rising score as acceptance falls is gaming inflation
